authorship: The four SVG files in assets are original programmatic artwork created for this project. The separate officialBrandAsset entry records the externally sourced DeepSeek mark.

assets.meaning: An open tutorial book with a lilac bookmark and visible page thickness.
Three reusable language blocks: code brackets, A, and a. No token counts or currency.
A puzzled lilac character with spiral eyes, a question mark, and a small yellow star.
The same character with closed blinking eyes. Outer silhouette, accessories, and coordinates match dizzy.svg.

integration: Load through browser Image or img. All graphics are self-contained paths and shapes with no fonts, scripts, external URLs, or embedded raster images. Character states share the same frame for direct replacement.
